name: Yoshino Ryouko
source:
Zodiac: Aquarius
Precise weight: 48.5 kg.

A beautiful and mature college student who never becomes upset or emotional, Ryouko usually speaks softly and thinks logically. Although she acts like an adult most of the time, she has a hidden desire to be protected by a strong man, Ryouko finds Shin'ya's masculinity quite overwhelming.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031014071144/http://www.pinkpineapple.co.jp/pinpai/xmas/character/character.html]official website[/url].]
